hardware.cpu: AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS with Radeon 680M Graphics (8 cores, 16 threads)

persistent_rlm.evidence: ReplSession in services/rlm/repl.py provides Python eval and dill snapshots, but root_agent.py bypassed the REPL loop with hardcoded prompt wrappers and direct LLM calls instead of true iterative RLM programmatic execution.
persistent_rlm.upstream_alignment: Needs full upstream rlm protocol compatibility (rlm.spawn, rlm.bash, rlm.harness, rlm.mcp, rlm.emit, rlm.host_request) and autonomous agent code execution loop.

subagents.evidence: Role definitions in services/subagents/roles.py exist and manager has in-memory tracking, but child sessions are not isolated processes with asynchronous protocol message passing.
subagents.upstream_alignment: Upgrade to real subagent execution with independent context, session dirs, and result collection.

continual_harness.evidence: services/rlm/harness.py implements key-value snapshotting, but lacks upstream HarnessEntry/HarnessScope schema, skills lifecycle (create_skill, update_skill), and immutable safety base policy.
continual_harness.upstream_alignment: Align with upstream rlm/harness.py and test real skill/memory refinement.

model_stack.evidence: GGUF models exist on disk and run on Vulkan, but previous documentation fabricated 4 out of 5 SHA256 hashes (draft, abliterated, vision, mmproj). Only Qwen3-4B hash was genuine. Real hashes verified via Get-FileHash.

rag.evidence: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings, BM25Okapi, and RRF reranking are functional. Verified in tests and CLI. Needs programmatic RLM API (await rag.search) and formal precision/recall benchmark.
rag.upstream_alignment: Expose structured evidence packs directly into REPL namespace.

vision.evidence: Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct + mmproj loads on Vulkan port 8081/8085 and executes OCR and visual QA on test images.
vision.upstream_alignment: Integrate with programmatic VLM tools and evaluate Qwen3-VL options.

image_generation.evidence: tiny-sd pipeline executes locally, but produces low-resolution toy outputs (256x256). Needs higher quality diffusion option or hardware-tuned profile.
image_generation.upstream_alignment: Separate image agent, on-demand loading, and semantic VLM requirement QA.

image_editing.evidence: Img2img applies generic noise transformation without mask/inpainting or semantic preservation. Visual QA relied solely on CV heuristics without VLM inspection.

mcp.evidence: services/mcp/server.py implements custom JSON-RPC tool calling, but does not adhere to official MCP stdio/SSE protocol specifications with schema discovery.
mcp.upstream_alignment: Align with upstream rlm/mcp.py and official MCP protocol specification.

memory_and_daemon.evidence: Memory serializes to JSON, but daemon heartbeat is an idle timer without stateful goal progression.
memory_and_daemon.upstream_alignment: Implement stateful goal progression and durable resume.

self_healing.evidence: Simple AST syntax checking exists, but lacks pre-repair snapshot, targeted test execution, regression verification, and automated rollback upon failure.
self_healing.upstream_alignment: Implement strict reversible repair cycle with snapshot/rollback.

speculative_and_kv.evidence: Speculative decoding flags work and achieve 26.9 tok/s, but comparative benchmarks (baseline vs speculative, KV cache F16 vs Q8/Q4, Flash Attention ON/OFF) were never measured.
speculative_and_kv.upstream_alignment: Execute real comparative matrix across configurations.
